Manet has developed a new training course to help athletes improve their time taken to run 800 m.
Manet claims that his course will decrease an athlete’s time by more than 2 s on average. For a random
sample of 10 athletes the times taken, in seconds, before and after the course are given in the following
table.
Athlete A B C D E F G H I J
Use a t-test, at the 5% significance level, to test whether Manet’s claim is justified, stating any
assumption that you make. [8]
